sources.title: Finance ministry softens bank law reforms aimed at curbing family control

quotes.text: The finance ministry is watering down proposed amendments to the bank company law meant to curb family control of banks. Although the current 12-year continuous tenure for a director is to be reduced to nine years, the limit of three directors from one family will remain the same.
